title: 第十六章：虚空聚灵阵
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

在东湖畔别墅里待了两天，陪何大哥和嫂子还有雪清一起在那。

因为有差不多一年时间没回地球了，还是先通过家人了解一下这边的情况。

第三天的时候。

苏行枫和雪清开着飞船一起回到了苏家村，自己的产业在这里要比联盟那还要好。

清枫山现在走的全是高端产业，这里回收和出售的都是顶级修炼资源，现在想要进入清枫山没有一定的资产你根本就进不去。

经过何大哥和嫂子的打理，再加上上官期的帮忙，清枫山现在扩大了百倍有余，现在整个苏家村都属于清枫山的范围了，而苏家村早就没了，现在苏家村里的人，全都被何大哥招入到产业中了，福利不知道有多好。

而他自己山上的院子，现在没人住，但是嫂子每隔几天都会去打扫一下。

回到山上院子里，打了个电话给上官期：“上官兄，好长时间没见了，过来叙叙旧吧？我这正好有点好东西，还有就是想让你组织一下人员，帮我一下忙“

因为现在无政府，所有大小事务全由联盟来做，所以上官期以前的官职就不存大了，而现在他主要的任务就是与苏行枫和白阳他们对接，再就是管理一下联盟里的事。

别看他这个职位看似很闲，但是他这个职位可是不知道有多少人看中，想要还得不到呢！谁让白阳说了，指定和上官期对接，其他人一律不理睬。

而每次白阳拿出来的好东西，上官期都会有一份，再有就是不管是什么，他都是第一个知道的。

上官期接到苏行枫的电话后，不知道有多高兴，和白阳比起来，这位才是金主啊！真真的好东西都在这苏行枫手上呢！

上官期挂断电话后就开着飞行器飞来了，前前后后没到十分钟。

因为山上阵法原因，不管谁都要从山下自己慢慢爬上来，所以上官期把飞行器停到山下，自己步行上了山，现在大家都修炼了，这点点山当不得什么，没几秒钟就上来了。

刚上来上官期见到苏行枫和雪清两个人坐在院子中就大叫着：“行枫，这么都快一年没见了吧！看看你，修为都看不透了，听白阳他们说你闭关了，这也太长时间了吧？“

苏行枫听到他的话，一阵恍然，看来上官期还不知道自己的事，所以他也点点头，默认了。

给他倒上一杯茶后说：“上官兄，这次我出关呢，是有几件事想要你们联盟帮忙，在联盟里，你们发布一个任务，收集所有'钼矿'，要精提炼的，而做为报酬，我这有一些系统性的修炼资源，我把东西给你们，你们自己去打算，我只要东西就行。“

他这次回来，主要的就是为贾老板口中所说的'钼矿'，而他自己也用智脑查过了一些资料，得到的结果是钼矿这东西，在星空界那边比稀土还稀缺，那边的计量单位都是以克为单位，所以他回地球时就向大家说了，自己可以弄到钱，就是为钼矿。

以他自己之前在火星和木星观察时，就发现了大量的钼矿存在。

他也不可能自己去开采，所以就要由上官期通过任务的方式发出去，这样全球人统一行动，用不了多长时间就可以弄到很多。

上官期听到后，心里一想，只要是苏行枫要的东西，定是好东西。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

I stayed at the villa by the East Lake for two days, accompanying Brother He, sister-in-law and Xue Qing there.

Since I haven't been back to Earth for almost a year, I'd better get to know the situation here through my family first.

On the third day.

Su Xingfeng and Xue Qing drove the spaceship back to Sujiacun. Their industry here was better than that of the alliance.

Qingfeng Mountain is now all about high-end industries. What is recycled and sold here are top-notch cultivation resources. If you want to enter Qingfeng Mountain now, you simply can't get in without certain assets.

After the care of Brother He and his sister-in-law, and the help of Shangguanqi, Qingfeng Mountain has now expanded more than a hundred times. Now the entire Sujia Village belongs to the scope of Qingfeng Mountain, and Sujia Village has long since disappeared. Now everyone in Sujia Village has been recruited into the industry by Brother He, and the welfare is not good.

As for his own yard on the mountain, no one lives in it now, but his sister-in-law will clean it every few days.

Returning to the courtyard on the mountain, he called Shangguanqi: "Brother Shangguan, I haven't seen you for a long time. Why don't you come over and catch up on old times? I happen to have some good stuff, and I also want you to organize some people and help me."

Because there is no government now, all matters big and small are done by the alliance, so the official position before Shangguanqi no longer exists, and now his main task is to communicate with Su Xingfeng and Bai Yang, and to manage the affairs of the alliance.

Even though his position seems to be very idle, there are countless people who are interested in his position, and they still can’t get it even if they want it!Who told Bai Yang to tell Shangguan Qi to contact him, but everyone else ignored him.

And every time Bai Yang brought out something good, Shangguan Qi would have a share, and no matter what it was, he would be the first to know.

After Shangguanqi received Su Xingfeng's call, he couldn't tell how happy he was. Compared with Bai Yang, this one was the financial sponsor!All the really good things are in the hands of Su Xingfeng!

After Shangguanqi hung up the phone, he flew over in his aircraft in less than ten minutes.

Because of the formation on the mountain, everyone had to climb up slowly from the bottom of the mountain, so Shangguanqi parked the aircraft at the bottom of the mountain and walked up the mountain. Now that everyone has practiced, this little bit of mountain is nothing, and they were up in a few seconds.

As soon as he came up, Shangguanqi saw Su Xingfeng and Xue Qing sitting in the courtyard and shouted, "Xingfeng, we haven't seen each other for almost a year! Look at you, you can't even see your cultivation level. I heard Bai Yang and the others said you were in seclusion. Isn't this too long?"

When Su Xingfeng heard what he said, he was suddenly enlightened. It seemed that Shangguanqi didn't know about his affairs yet, so he nodded and acquiesced.

After pouring him a cup of tea, he said: "Brother Shangguan, I am out of seclusion this time. I have a few things that I want your alliance to help with. In the alliance, you have issued a task to collect all the "molybdenum ore" and refine it. In return, I have some systematic training resources. I will give you the things and you can plan for it yourself. I only need the things."

The main reason he came back this time was for the "molybdenum ore" that Boss Jia said, and he himself checked some information with his brain, and the result was that molybdenum ore is scarcer than rare earths in the starry sky world, and the measurement unit there is in grams, so when he returned to Earth, he told everyone that he could get money for the molybdenum ore.

In his previous observations on Mars and Jupiter, he discovered the existence of large amounts of molybdenum ore.

It is impossible for him to mine it himself, so Shangguan Qi has to send it out through tasks. In this way, people all over the world can act in unison and get a lot of it in a short time.

After Shangguan Qi heard this, he thought to himself that as long as it was something Su Xingfeng wanted, it would be a good thing.
